outcome: Mortality rates of very low birth weight (VLBW) infants
cohort: Singleton very low birth weight (VLBW) infants of 24-32 weeks' gestation from the Israel national VLBW infant database
finding: The decrease in preterm VLBW infant mortality was attributable predominantly to changes in variable specific mortality rates whereas changes in the proportions of demographic, perinatal risk factors, and therapies had a limited impact on VLBW infant mortality.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery contributed to 8.1% of the decrease in mortality.
